correctness.rationale: On flat Klein K_(a,b), shortest geodesic parity between representatives is determined by whether |x_i-x_j|/a exceeds 1/2 + u_ij, u_ij=[d_b(y_i+y_j)^2-d_b(y_i-y_j)^2]/(2a²), |u_ij|<=δ=b²/(8a²)<=1/8. Boolean odd-parity identity is sum singles−2sum pair intersections+4 triple intersection. Integrating over independent uniform horizontal variables gives singles (1−h)^2, exact shared-vertex pair tail I(h,k), and triple simplex volume. Their conditional expansion equals 1/4+2sum u_i²−(sum u_i)²+E, |E|<=56δ³; direct independent evaluation at four nonzero u triples corroborated the cubic bound. Fourier of periodic squared vertical distance gives Ez_ij=0, Ez_ij²=b^4/90, Ez_ij z_jk=0, so average quadratic correction b^4/(120a^4). Error 56δ³=7/64*(b/a)^6. Unique shortest geodesic a.s. and orientation character well-defined for self-crossing loop; positivity threshold sufficient not claimed optimal.
